simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to גָּזָם (H1501) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: גָּזָם (gâzâm) means a kind of locust First listed occurrence: Amos 4 9.

definitions.full: H1501. gazam גָּזָם noun masculine Amos 4:9 locusts (collective) — absolute גָּזָם Joel 1:4 ; 2:25 ; Amos 4:9 ; — always as devouring, devastating, Joel 1:4 (|| חָסִיל יֶלֶק, אַרְבֶּה, ) 2:25 (|| id. ); Amos 4:9 alone: your gardens and your vineyards, and your fig-tres and your olive-trees הַגָּזָם יאֹכַל .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to devour;
